title: Looking Ahead With the Body: A Short Horizon Controller for the Body's Sideways Balance, With the Foot's Limit Built Into the Problem

artifact.note: a model predictive controller in its short form for the body's balance in one direction: the body as the inverted pendulum of 35-02 (position and velocity relative to the middle of the support, with x'' = (g/h) (x - p) for a ZMP at p), the ZMP bounded by the feet's extent, the exact discrete model over a time step, the predictions over a horizon written as matrices in the sequence of ZMP commands, the quadratic cost of the position and velocity along it and of the commands, and the constrained minimum found by a projected gradient method (a step down the gradient, then the bounds); only the first command is used and the problem is solved again at the next step; compared with a fixed gain law that is clipped at the bound, by the largest push each can recover from
